facts.summary: FDA issued complete response letter citing CMC and non-clinical issues; no new clinical data requested · Filed · GTx-104 in aSAH · filed for approval

evidence.summary: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has issued a Complete Response Letter (CRL) for the Company’s New Drug Application (NDA) for GTx-104 for the treatment of patients with aSAH.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: The trial met its primary endpoint, with patients receiving GTx-104 observed to have a 19% reduction in at least one incidence of clinically significant hypotension compared to oral nimodipine (28% versus 35%).
evidence.safety: No deaths were determined to be related to GTx-104 or oral nimodipine.
evidence.program_discontinued: Company Intends to Resubmit Application Following Resolution of Cited Items
